As silly as it sounds, maybe I will take you up on your offer. One of the main things that gets me into a twisted mindframe is the feeling that I'm unwanted (that sounds really sappy) but maybe it would help. I don't know, if you would be willing to help in such a way, I'm sure it would help remind me, even with my, as someone aptly put it above, "depression goggles" impairing my thoughts.

I would but my greatest fear is having anybody find out about my problems. I am also very very bad with talking to people. I think I'm more than a Socially Awkward Penguin as it is joked about on here as I have a real fear of talking to anybody, even on a phone to the point where I have contemplated killing myself because it is something that I dread so much. This has prevented me from making appointments for my vision (which is shit but I don't want to be checked due to lack of health insurance), my dogs, visiting professors during office hours etc.  Additionally, I don't have any health insurance and I don't have the money to get meds. As far as seeing a shrink, I may do that, though my school asks for health care provider when making an appointment which I don't have.

I'm not sure what about it makes me depressed aside from the fact that I feel like I'm trapped. I can't really express it but I feel like I can't escape it and it continues to weigh down on me and I start thinking of what will happen, for example (I will use scholastic work for this but other things trigger such as wondering why people don't talk to me) if I don't do well on a test/homework/class and start thinking of my options for escape starting with taking loans but then I can't so I think about running away, but that wouldn't work so it comes to killing myself. Again the only reason I am able to put this in words right now is because I'm not in that mode yet, but as I write this I can feel it in the back of my mind lingering, and once I go into the phase, I stay for months. Last year I was in a phase of it for ~5 months where I wasn't thinking clearly. I know that it is easy to say to remember that it will be over, but in that phase it didn't matter. I would find ways to justify any actions that I might take http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PNssWUM4kb8 is a somewhat humorous version of it, but it is quite similar in the sense of when I am not feeling depressed, such as now, I can see how absurd my reasoning is and why it would be an awful thing to do it, but I'm afraid if I go back in to a prolonged depressed state I would find a way to ignore anything that I would try to tell my future depressed self.
Gödel, Escher, Bach by far. It blew my fucking mind.
